title: First Phase Restoration: Basilica’s $7.7m repairs halt leaks; visitors face limited hours
summary_full: The historic basilica in Asheville, North Carolina, recently marked the successful completion of its first restoration phase, costing $7.7 million. This essential initiative concentrated on addressing water damage and safeguarding the architectural masterpiece. Key upgrades included the replacement of the copper dome and reinforcing key masonry sections, paving the way for future restoration phases that rely on ongoing fundraising efforts and the building's status as a cultural treasure.
